note: Issue #95: what the mechanic in the desert sells for a speeder. Read by src/systems/vehicles/speeder_upgrades.gd (prices, rules, stats) and src/systems/world/speeder_shop.gd (the shop, its words). Issue #295: 'mechanic' is Dorrin's shop; 'shops' holds the others (Skrugs's garage bench, free roam only), each laid over Dorrin's block (SpeederUpgrades.shop), so the menu, parts and prices are the same and only the name, bay and words change. A part has a slot; a speeder holds one part per slot, except 'paint', which can be bought again. 'requires' is the part before it in its line (tier 2 needs tier 1, and replaces it). 'mods' multiply the speeder's numbers in content/core/vehicles/speeder.json ('laser.damage' reaches into the laser). 'hover' turns on the Grav Lifter in hover_model.gd. Looks-only parts change nothing but the look. Scrap pays 'base' plus 'parts_back' of what was spent on parts. Issue #627: a part with a 'model' fits only that vehicle (content/core/vehicles/<model>.json; none = the Sand-boxer), and a vehicle's 'shop_groups' limit the menu (the racer and the box truck: paint only); a vehicle's 'scrap_base' replaces 'base'. Issue #615: a part's `unlocked_by` names a race crew (content/core/racing/crews/): in story mode it is for sale only once you have beaten them, and the menu says whose leader to beat; in free roam everything is for sale. Issue #616: race gear (group "race"): seekers, mines and a deflector carry a `gear` block (SpeederGear: load, refill, damage, lock cone and range; a mine's blast is the grenade's keys); nitro tiers are plain mods on boost_time and boost_recharge. Speeder classes: `shared_groups` are the groups whose parts (with no 'model') fit every vehicle, so the racer and the box truck take the same engines, thrusters, cannons, race gear and Grav Lifter as the Sand-boxer; paint and looks stay the Sand-boxer's. A mod on a number the vehicle does not have (an engine's boost_speed on the box truck, which drifts) does nothing. Balance: a laser bolt is 15% of a Sand-boxer, a seeker (hit and splash) or a mine a third, so three of either wreck one; the racer has half its health and the box truck three times.
